text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.golangci.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: golangci-lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: make lint
```
